About

Hey! I’m Issam, a Computer Science and AI student at IE University. I’m Jordanian, but I spent most of my life growing up in Dubai, and these days I’m living in Madrid.

What really gets me going is full-stack AI engineering, especially building AI workflows and figuring out how all the pieces talk to each other. I like to move fast, and my favourite problems are the ones that need some serious system design to crack.

I’m looking for work right now, so if you’re building something cool with AI, I’d love to hear about it. Just send me an email!

Hobbies

  • I’ve been playing rugby for eleven years at national and international level in the UAE and Jordan, and I’m still out on the pitch here in Spain.
  • I also compete in arm wrestling, which is exactly as fun as it sounds.
  • I’m very comfortable in front of a camera after doing fashion modeling campaigns. I’d love to act one day, and right now I’m directing my very own horror short film.
  • Chemistry has a way of pulling me in, so in my free time I love going down rabbit holes about pharmacy.

02

Career

FOUNDER · NOW

Pharmable

I’m building AI that reviews pharmaceutical documents against health regulations before they’re submitted, so teams catch problems long before a regulator does.

AWARD · 3RD OF 18 TEAMS

First Claude Hackathon in Madrid

A 48-hour hackathon where AI agents faced off in a live trading game and every deal had to be negotiated. We built an agent that negotiated on its own and kept learning from rival teams as the game went on. It even ran its own marketplace where other teams came to trade, and we finished 3rd out of 18.

INTERNSHIP

AI Engineer · Optimiza

I built an AI tool that turns raw meeting transcripts into clear summaries and flags the moments where a client sounds unhappy, which replaced a review process people used to do by hand. Along the way I also configured IIS web services across virtual machines and built a chatbot with Hugging Face Transformers and TensorFlow, served through Flask.

INTERNSHIP

Data Scientist · British Airways

I built an automated system that collected over 13,000 records of competitor fares and seat availability across six routes over two years. Digging into the data uncovered a 29% rise in winter delays and showed demand falling as fares went up on every route, which directly shaped how the airline scheduled its capacity.

AWARD · 1ST PLACE

EDP × IE Datathon

The challenge was to run battery energy storage systems more efficiently. The batteries charge when solar panels make more power than the grid needs and release it when demand picks up. We predicted supply and demand with multivariate time series forecasting, and our model came first in accuracy.

RESEARCH

IE Tech Lab × Bloomberg

I co-developed a Bloomberg-sponsored ESG trust score that helps investors judge how companies do on sustainability, along with a simplified Bloomberg Terminal built for everyday investors. I got to work directly with the Bloomberg team the whole way through.

RESEARCH

IE Econ Data Lab × UNDP

A comparative study for the United Nations Development Programme on how cities in North America and South Asia invest in resilience against disasters and other shocks, built on years of economic time series data.

Projects

AIREGULATORY REVIEWFOUNDER

Pharmable

My startup! Pharmable uses AI to check pharmaceutical documents against health regulations before they’re submitted. It points out anything that’s missing and shows exactly which rule applies, so teams can fix problems early and spend far less time on review.

Visit pharmable.dev ↗
C++20PYTHONQUANT FINANCE

Schrödinger Local Vol

Yes, that Schrödinger. This prices SPX options by solving a Schrödinger equation in imaginary time with a C++ Crank-Nicolson solver. I backtested it on 1.2 million real SPX quotes against SVI, Heston and the practitioner smile, and it came out with zero butterfly arbitrage across 2,019 holdout slices.

View source ↗

Vocable

Point it at any webpage and it reads the whole thing out loud, keeping the speech synced to each sentence so you can follow along. When the writing gets dense, it can translate the page or explain it in simpler words.

PYTHONNLPML EVALUATION

Optimus

The AI voice meeting assistant I worked on during my internship at Optimiza, published here using the public AMI meeting corpus. It labels dialogue acts across 90,142 segments and writes meeting summaries, with ROUGE scores to keep them honest. It also comes with a CLI and tests that run offline.

04

Game Dev

Hand-drawn canvas

Every pixel here is drawn on a 2D canvas with my own code. There’s no game engine and no libraries, just a whole lot of tiny rectangles.

Walking around

You can stroll around with the keyboard or the touch pad. Cabins and trees get in your way like they should, and a little prompt pops up whenever you’re close to something.

Cabins you can enter

Every cabin has its own cozy room inside. Walk up to the book on the lectern and it opens that part of my portfolio.

Opening scene

When you hit start, the camera swoops down to my cabin and I walk out the door to say hi.

A living farm

Scroll all the way down and you’ll find a farm running on little loops, from a farmer fetching water to a camper who keeps burning marshmallows.

Accessibility

It respects reduced motion and works with just a keyboard. And if you’d rather not play at all, everything is right here to read.

A cozy woodland homestead: a farmhouse with a grandfather rocking on the porch, a vegetable garden and scarecrow, a stone well, a turning windmill, a washing line and beehives, with a farmer and dog doing chores above a paddock of horses, highland cows, chickens and pigs.
